lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Ah, you stayed until the end! Most people leave after the last encore. Did you like the show?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I did. But I also noticed the deck box on your bag.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: You… noticed that? Usually people only see the ribbons and the lights.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Do you play?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Play? I live for it! The stage is fun, but opening a new pack still makes my heart race more than any spotlight.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Want to see my binder? I keep it with me even on show days.

choices.label: Ask to see her favorite cards
choices.reply: Really?! Okay, okay, sit down — these are my babies!

choices.label: Tell her the real smile just now was better than the stage one
choices.reply: Ehh?! Don’t say that so suddenly… but thank you.

choices.label: Tease her gently about being an idol who loves Grass-types
choices.reply: Hey! Grass-types are cool! Don’t make fun of my perfect evolution lines!

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I've got half an hour before vocal warm-ups. I brought a deck and an alarm. This is efficiency.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You set an alarm for cards?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: For rehearsal! Don't worry. My band would never let me forget a call time.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And you want to spend your break playing?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Only if you promise not to treat this like a fan meet. I need someone who'll actually challenge me.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Look, I even brought my serious sleeves. Purple means business.

choices.label: Give her a serious practice match
choices.reply: Yes! Thank you. Now stop smiling at me and shuffle.

choices.label: Ask how she balances rehearsal and tournaments
choices.reply: Not gracefully. My rehearsal bag has three deck boxes and not enough spare socks.

choices.label: Tell her she's adorable when she gets competitive
choices.reply: That's not fair! I spent ages perfecting this intimidating face.

openingByFlag.rina_binder: You looked at my binder last time. I’ve been thinking about which cards to show you next!
openingByFlag.rina_real: You said my real smile was better. I’ve been practicing not hiding it as much.
openingByFlag.rina_tease: You teased me about Grass-types. I’m still defending them with my whole heart!

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I wrote tomorrow's set list on the back of my deck notes. Guess which one needs more work.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: How's rehearsal going?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Good! I keep mixing up the transitions. The drummer asked if I was calling attacks.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You could bring the cards to rehearsal.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I did. They all have favorite Pokémon now. I thought they'd laugh, but they've been helping me test.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Want to hear the chorus? I borrowed the rhythm from the shuffling game at the shop.

choices.label: Ask to hear the song and help test the deck
choices.reply: Okay! But you have to promise not to call the chorus a bad matchup if I mess up.

choices.label: Ask what she would change if the show were entirely hers
choices.reply: I'd add a song the whole band writes together. No choreography for that one.

choices.label: Tell her you like seeing her this excited
choices.reply: I'm trying not to bounce in my seat. It's not working, is it?

openingByFlag.rina_serious: You played me for real last time. So I’m being real with you now.
openingByFlag.rina_grounded: You asked if the idol life gets in the way. Today it doesn’t. Today is just us.
openingByFlag.rina_happy: You said I look happiest with cards. I’m testing that theory right now.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I finished early today. No encore for the crowd… but I saved one for you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: A private encore?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Just a song I like. And then maybe a match under the lights of the streetlamps. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: More than okay.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Good. Because I’ve been practicing both the song and the deck. I wanted them to be ready at the same time.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: You’re the first person I’ve wanted to share both with.

choices.label: Listen to the song, then play her with everything you have
choices.reply: That’s the best answer you could have given me.

choices.label: Tell her you’re honored she chose you for both
choices.reply: Honored… That’s a big word. But I feel the same way about showing you.

choices.label: Close the distance after the song and stay close
choices.reply: The streetlamps are really bright tonight… or maybe that’s just my face.

openingByFlag.rina_both: You said both versions were worth knowing. So I’m giving you both tonight.
openingByFlag.rina_future: You asked what I wanted beyond the next show. Part of the answer is this.
openingByFlag.rina_fell: You said you fell for the card-obsessed version first. I’m still replaying that.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I asked my manager to leave Saturday free. The shop's doing a charity match, and my band offered to play afterward.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Cards and a concert on the same day?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Yeah! The set list's nearly done. Finding a rhyme for Bulbasaur is harder than it sounds.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You don't have to put Pokémon in every song.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I know. But I'd like to try. I'm tired of waiting for someone else to decide which parts of my life go together.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: There's still one thing I haven't figured out. Will you be there when the lights go down?

choices.label: Promise you'll keep showing up as a friend and practice partner
choices.reply: Please do! The drummer still thinks I make up half these card names. I need backup.

choices.label: Tell her you want to be her partner beyond the stage
choices.reply: I was hoping you'd say that. Come to the next show as my date? I'll save you a seat.

choices.label: Ask what she wants after the season, without deciding for her
choices.reply: A new song, a new deck, and a Saturday that isn't booked solid. Let's start there.

openingByFlag.rina_share: You shared the song and the match with me. I’m still glowing about it.
openingByFlag.rina_honored: You said you were honored. I’ve been carrying that word around all week.
openingByFlag.rina_close: You stayed close after the song. The streetlamps aren’t the only thing that felt bright.
